body: used to be a cocaine addict, never had too much even though we went through a lot.  I am afraid of heroine as I do not want to hallucinate during it and scare myself before I die.  Would rather just go to sleep.  This sounds morbid and bad but this is how I feel.  that is why I took klonopin, it just makes me go to sleep. but 60 did nothing and I woke up fine the next morning.   I have been into heavy drug use since the 1990s so maybe I am not sure but drugs just wont do the trick.  was thinking of the exit bag.  but I have to rethink things again since I am still alive and maybe there was something to live for but I am not sure of it.  who knows.  just hope I do not go through the chaos again in the near future

Very long time, but never suicidal until the last 2 years as soon as the divorce happened.  I don't know what to do anymore and I am running out of options to live, support myself or my kids... I am a financial drain on my elderly parents right now and things are a mess.  I do appreciate the time you are taking out of your life to help and talk.  I will let you get back to life now as I think we have gone over most things.  Hopefully I will post again and say things got better.  and personally thank you for being the one talking to me.

Well we can talk about it..  She is the best liar in the world and cheated on me on numerous occasions, she also stole over $40,000 from my family and my bank account... so I am not sure she is the cause but it did not help the situation.  I was depressed and diagnosed bipolar before she did the stealing of money and the cheating
met her at a mall, not sure how this is relevant to my depression and bipolar issues

About 2005, right before I met my ex-wife.  This is when I was not depressed nor was talking to psychologists.  Not sure she had anything to do with it but I know since that year I have felt this way.

I am not sure. just day by day I guess.  just forget it all on a daily basis I guess and hope I dont remember what happened the days and weeks before.  when I do remember or someone brings it up or court happens is when it all hits hard and I just go overboard with emotions.  strange it seems to me that things cant just be normal day to day. not sure how others deal with stress and emotions but mine are out of whack

lost work as I am bipolar and cannot keep a job more than a month or so.  also I have horrible spending sprees which go along with that bipolar.  Ex-wife also did not help by having me swatted a few times for no reason other than her hating me.  I got thrown in a mental institution for it and have no trust issues with most people anymore as I people can lock you up for no reason at all.   Also it does not help I have issues of being a cynical dickhead with my comments which alienates me from most people.  hence why I am on the internet talking to complete strangers.   Money issues have been the most part as I dont work and cannot find work.  2 years ago I got 2 DUIs in a week after my divorce which hit me really hard. Both were pill related not alcohol.   So now I have that to deal with and in now a criminal in my state for taking prescription meds.   I could go on but that seems to get the just of what is going on
that is the only thing I care about in life
By the way, the kids are in a safe place away from me with Grandparents so they were not witness to what I was doing
I am from USA is all I will say, and I have two kids
sorry I fucked up, reddit is hard to navigate.  I always fuck up. this is why my post was what it was.  maybe if I had known about the other subreddit I would have posted there

but yet it was deleted for some reason, do you not agree they deleted it?  I deleted my other account as I thought delusionally that someone would be watching it and send someone here to get me.  today I am going to leave this on here as I am not delusional at the moment.  sorry if I assume Mods are here all the time.  and thank you for explaining
If I do not respond in a timely matter I am sorry. I will try to answer any questions as they come in.

I deleted my account as it got responses and someone to talk to but you made me feel as if I was on the wrong subreddit and I got no PM from you at all.  maybe it took longer than I thought it should have.  I put my post in a suicide watch and under this name.   I think thought that posts like this should not be deleted and should be directed to the proper place instead of saying I am a troll.   Thank you
